scenes.heading: Building a repeatable client onboarding process

sents.d: Building a repeatable client onboarding process
A structured onboarding process reduces early mistakes and mismatched expectations.

A VA onboarding process typically includes gathering access to necessary accounts and tools, understanding the client's existing systems and preferences, and agreeing on communication norms (response time expectations, preferred channels).

Documenting how the client currently does a task before changing anything — even if you plan to suggest improvements — respects their existing systems and avoids disrupting things they may rely on in ways that aren't immediately obvious.
Setting a check-in cadence (weekly during the first month, then monthly) during onboarding ensures early misunderstandings surface and get corrected quickly rather than accumulating silently.

take: Learn their systems first and check in often early on.
